headline: Q3-2026 Profits of 5 State-Owned Banks: Largest Rp48 T, Highest Growth 22%
summary: Five Indonesian state-owned banks reported Q3 2026 results, with the largest profit at Rp48 trillion. The fastest growing bank's profit rose 22 percent.
why: State-owned banks are major lenders in Indonesia, and their earnings reflect credit growth and asset quality across the banking system. Their results are closely watched by investors in Indonesian financials.
original_headline: Adu Laba 5 Bank BUMN Q3-2026: Terbesar Rp48 T, Tertinggi Tumbuh 22%
